name: jestats-screamingfrog-audit
description: Technical SEO audits, evidence-backed priorities, and interactive offline reports from local Screaming Frog crawls.
long_description: Connects to the visible, licensed Screaming Frog SEO Spider through localhost MCP. Nine tools manage local audit jobs, immutable snapshots, findings, and HTML/CSV reports. Controlled macOS pipeline, new/saved findings equivalence, and actual MCP report generation passed. Version 0.1.2 remains provisional while analysis readiness, applied preset settings, Windows native checks, offline browser checks, and assistant-host installation journeys are verified. New crawls default to a genuine macOS 24.3 native preset, with advanced configPath or explicit current-settings overrides available.

endpoint.title: Screaming Frog MCP URL
endpoint.description: The localhost MCP URL shown by your running Screaming Frog application.

data_dir.title: Local audit storage
data_dir.description: Optional directory for audit jobs, immutable snapshots, and reports. Leave blank to use .jestats/screamingfrog in your home directory.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Diagnose local connectivity, native capabilities, crawl identity, and readiness.

tools.name: list_crawls
tools.description: List saved native database crawls without loading them.

tools.name: start_audit
tools.description: Queue an audit from a saved crawl ID or a configured new crawl.

tools.name: list_audits
tools.description: Find persisted local audit jobs after reconnecting.

tools.name: audit_status
tools.description: Reconcile and advance an audit job, reporting coverage and required actions.

tools.name: control_audit
tools.description: Pause, resume, or cancel an identified audit.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: Query bounded findings by category, priority, and site section.

tools.name: finding_details
tools.description: Inspect a finding and paginated affected URLs with supporting evidence.

tools.name: render_report
tools.description: Write a local offline HTML report and CSV exports with advisory narrative.
